* **Maximum Speed:** 60–65 mph (or 5 mph belowposted speed limit, whichever is lower). U-Haul towing/loading heavily degrades braking distance and stability.
* **Height & Clearance:** Measure and write U-Haul total overhead clearance (e.g., 12' 6") on a sticky note attached to the steering wheel dashboard. Watch low hotel overhangs and drive-thrus.
* **Fuel Stop Intervals:** Governed by the lowest-range vehicle (typically U-Haul ~250–300 miles per tank). Plan fuel stops every **180–220 miles** or at 1/4 tank remaining to avoid running dry in rural stretches.
